test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person can row 5 m/sec in still water. The speed of the stream is 6 km/h. The time (in hours) taken by him to row a distance of 76.8 km downstream is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the boat in still water = 5 m/sec

Speed of the stream = 6 km/h

Distance to be covered = 76.8 km 

**Formulas used:**

Speed downstream = Speed of the boat + Speed of the stream 

Time = Distance/Speed 

**Calculation:**

Speed of the boat in km/h = 5 m/sec × 18/5 

⇒ 18 km/h 

∴ Required time = 76.8/(18 + 6) 

⇒ 76.8/24 

**⇒ 3.2 hours**
